## About the data

Every dataset in this course is real and traces to a named public source — the
Pennsylvania Department of Health, the CDC, or the EPA. County-level figures are reported
as published, including their suppression rules and known limitations.

## Labs and homework

**Labs** are worked during the lab session and submitted to Canvas by midnight that same
day. There are six labs across the Python half, and the lowest grade is dropped.

**Homework** is completed on [DataCamp](https://www.datacamp.com), not on this site. Each
homework is an assigned set of DataCamp chapters covering the module just finished, due by
midnight the day before the next lecture. Homework is graded on completion, recorded
automatically — there is nothing to upload to Canvas. See Canvas and the syllabus for the
assigned chapters and exact due dates.

## Software

Coursework is completed in [Google Colab](https://colab.research.google.com). The slides on
this site run Python directly in the browser through
[Pyodide](https://pyodide.org), which requires no account and no installation.
